<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Get all current green blocks and click on each one
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
greens = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']

# Calculate center of each green block for clicking
click_targets = []
for g in greens:
    boundary = g['boundary']
    # Get min/max row and col from boundary
    rows = [p[0] for p in boundary]
    cols = [p[1] for p in boundary]
    center_row = sum(rows) // len(rows)
    center_col = sum(cols) // len(cols)
    click_targets.append((center_row, center_col, g['id']))

# Click on all green blocks
for row, col, gid in click_targets:
    result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': row, 'col': col}])

    if last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('level_completed'):
        print(f"Level completed! Score: {last_action_result.get('score')}")
        break

# Check remaining green blocks
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
greens = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
